messages.author: e8bdfd51f8bc5695
messages.subject: Plotting a graph for SVM
parts:
I wanted to know is there any graph for plotting the SVM. Or if there is any other method of Visualising SVM for the given dataset

library(e1071)
cmc<-read.table("cmc.data",sep=",")
colnames(cmc) <- c("wifeAge.V1", "wifeEdu.V2","husbandEdu.V3","numChildren.V4","wifeRelig.V5","wifeWorkin.V6","husbandWork.V7","SOLI.V8","MediaExp.V9","contaMethod.V10")

cmc$contaMethod.V10=as.factor(cmc$contaMethod.V10)
intrain <- createDataPartition(y = cmc$contaMethod.V10, p= 0.7, list = FALSE)
trainset<- cmc[intrain,]

testset<- cmc[-intrain,]

model <- svm(contaMethod.V10~., data = trainset)

prediction <- predict(model, testset[,-10])
tab <- table(pred = prediction, true = testset[,10])
confusionMatrix(prediction,testset[,10])
